purpose: Make DOVA-SYNDROME / OpenTracks the preferred third-party free BGM discovery source for future video production, with a curated starting set and semantic selection rules so the user does not need to restate preferred songs.

source.name: DOVA-SYNDROME / OpenTracks transition
source.acquisition_rule: Use the official download flow. Do not scrape or bulk-collect the site with bots/programmatic crawlers. Reverify site and creator terms before a new acquisition batch.
source.content_id_rule: Never register DOVA/OpenTracks library music or a video containing it as exclusive ownership of the library track in Content ID.

steps: Classify the video or semantic segment by mood, gravity and narration density.
Check the curated DOVA set first, then search DOVA/OpenTracks for a better semantic match if necessary.
Reverify current site license and creator-specific conditions before downloading a new asset.
Use the official download flow; never automate bulk scraping of DOVA/OpenTracks.
Store title, creator, source URL, license evidence, acquisition date, SHA-256, duration and mood tags with the local production asset.
Choose one coherent BGM per semantic section; do not swap music merely to create activity.
Duck or automate BGM around narration, major sound effects and emotionally emphasized speech.
Use intentional silence before important evidence, corrections, reveals or grave statements when it improves contrast.
Apply track cooldown/rotation so recurring videos do not sound mechanically identical.

sensitive_topic_override.rule: For deaths, disasters, serious accidents, victim harm, war casualties, medical emergencies and harmful misinformation corrections, suppress cheerful/funny BGM and prefer restrained neutral music or silence.
